title: Sam's Trip
text:
Sam likes to travel. Today he takes a bus to the airport. The bus is big and yellow. Sam sits by the window.

At the airport, Sam finds his plane. The plane is white and very fast. Sam has a ticket for seat twelve. He is happy to fly to the sea.

questions.text: What seat does Sam have on the plane?
How does Sam feel about his trip?
Why does Sam take a bus to the airport?
options: He needs to get to the airport
He wants to buy a bus
He wants to sleep on the bus
He works as a bus driver

vocabulary.definition: a place where planes take off and land
an opening in a wall or vehicle that lets in light and air
a paper or card that allows you to travel or enter a place
a large vehicle that flies in the sky

paragraph_translations: Сем любить подорожувати. Сьогодні він їде автобусом до аеропорту. Автобус великий і жовтий. Сем сидить біля вікна.
В аеропорту Сем знаходить свій літак. Літак білий і дуже швидкий. У Сема є квиток на дванадцяте місце. Він радий летіти до моря.
